draft.subject: Subject: Update: Replacement Vehicle Dispatched for Apex Chemicals Shipment
draft.body:
Subject: Update: Replacement Vehicle Dispatched for Apex Chemicals Shipment

Dear Apex Chemicals Team,

Please be advised that the vehicle with registration UP37UP7482 experienced a mechanical breakdown during transit.
A replacement vehicle, registration UP53YM5558, has been dispatched from our Lucknow hub to continue the route to Ludhiana.
The estimated time of arrival for the shipment is approximately 21.6 hours from the time of dispatch.
We apologize for the delay and will keep you updated on the progress.

Best regards,
Meridian Freight Dispatch
